question: Should OpenClaw accept this signed marketplace feed trust boundary and land it after the predecessor signed-envelope/config PRs?
rationale: The code path decides which hosted marketplace feed bodies are trusted and adds persisted trust metadata, which is a maintainer/security decision even though the patch has no concrete correctness finding.

options.title: Accept after predecessor stack
options.body: Land or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316, then merge this slice with the signed-feed security model intact.

options.title: Request trust-model changes
options.body: Ask for a narrower or different envelope/trust-state contract before this becomes the marketplace refresh behavior.

options.title: Pause the trust series
options.body: Keep this PR open or close/rework the stack if signed hosted feed trust is not a product direction maintainers want now.

recommendation.title: Accept after predecessor stack
recommendation.body: Land or rebase after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98299 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98316, then merge this slice with the signed-feed security model intact.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the recent hosted marketplace feed implementation history and authored the trust-stack design under review.
